row.proto: void Sess_WeekendOptions_Refresh(void *comp, bool force, bool post)
row.notes: Refresh of game::championship::WeekendOptionsComponent (method name not recovered; same TU as Sess_WeekendOptions_OnRaceLengthChanged, every caller takes the component from the entity registry by key 0x14605b388). rcx = component W, edx = force (bpl, stored [rsp+0x36] at 0x140be774c), r8d = post (bl, stored [rsp+0x37] at 0x140be7513); no return value is read by any caller. Copies the stored setup [W+0x210] into a new one on the stack (0x142a322e0 at 0x140be74e0, rsp+0x50); returns at once when the entity [W+0x278] registry (+0x1030 vt+0x10) holds component 0x14605b068. Reads the options store [W+0x310] by name with Game_OptionsStore_FindOption: weekend_structure (0 never sprint, 1 by track, 2 always sprint; new byte at [rsp+0x128]), starting_grid, race_length (or the variant names at 0x14568ea28), qualifying_length, practice_type, practice_length. Structure 1 takes the current weekend from entity+0x1030 vt+0x90, its track index byte +0x278 into [[entity+0xf58]+0x28] stride 0x10, and Game_TrackData_GetTrack(...)+0xfd (sprint flag). The session formats come from [W+0x498] (else entity+0x2b0) +0x198..+0x1a0 stride 0x88 matched on byte +0x80 = sprint, else W+0x330. Compares with the stored copy at W+0x3b8 (maps +0x3b8/+0x400/+0x448 by 0x142a333b0/0x142a33600/0x142a33850, structure byte +0x490) at 0x140be7e5d-0x140be7eab: all equal and force 0 -> skips to 0x140be860b with no copy and no post. Otherwise copies the new setup into W+0x3b8.., stores +0x490 (0x140be85c8) and, when post, posts weekend_setup_changed_message (type 0x1456895d0, slot +8 0x140ce1470 returns the name 0x14568d856; payload +0x10 = [W+0x278] entity) with Ne_Post_BusMessage on [g_Game_MessageBus+8] at 0x140be8606. Callers: seven option-change lambdas 0x142b6db80.. (force 0 post 1), 0x142b6f60e (force 0 post 0), .data1 0x149932641 (force 1 post 1), 0x14de8c14c (force 1 post 1, tail jmp), 0x14deabb19 (0,1), and the season-document options syncer 0x14de931d0 at 0x14de93313 (0,1, after its own +0x3c counter is dropped, so that counter does not cover this call).
